# CirclePack license evidence

Ken Stephenson's software page identifies CirclePack as his copyrighted software and permits use and distribution under the GNU General Public License:
https://www.circlepack.com/software.html

The author's older version log states the same grant:
https://web.math.utk.edu/~kens/CirclePack/log.html

The repository does not supply a top-level license file. The GPL version is not specified in these notices. COPYING supplies GPL version 3's full text; it is not represented as a file retrieved from CirclePack. The source revision and original Git blob identities are recorded in sources.tsv.
